title: My Red Car
moral: When we help each other, we can travel together down roads we could never travel alone.
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본. text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. reuse 는 narration_el_en.js 의 영어 녹음 그대로, new 만 새로 녹음한다(trim 없음). 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

acts.hook:click | convoy:line | convoy:drive: 견인 고리 걸기·한 줄 서기·줄지어 달리기

lines.text: 이현이의 방에 작은 빨간 장난감 자동차가 있었어요.
lines.en: In Ihyun's room, there was a little red toy car.
segs: In Ihyun's room, there was a little red toy car.

lines.text: 이현이는 빨간 자동차를 참 좋아했어요.
lines.en: Ihyun loved the little red car very much.
segs: Ee-hyun loved the little red car very much.

lines.text: 방 안에는 파란 블록, 노란 오리, 그리고 반짝반짝 빨간 자동차가 있었지요.
lines.en: In his room were a blue block, a yellow duck, and a shiny, sparkly little red car.
segs: In his room were a blue block, a yellow duck, and a shiny, sparkly little red car.

lines.text: 부릉부릉! 이현이는 날마다 자동차를 씽씽 굴리며 놀았어요.
lines.en: Vroom, vroom! Every day Ihyun played with the car, zooming it all around.
segs: Vroom, vroom! Every day Ihyun played with the car, zooming it all around.

lines.text: 밥 먹을 때도 냠냠, 잠잘 때도 쌔근, 언제나 손에 꼭 쥐고 있었지요.
lines.en: Munch munch at mealtime, snore snore at bedtime, the red car was always in Ihyun's hand.
segs: Munch munch at mealtime, snore snore at bedtime, the red car was always in Ee-hyun's hand.

lines.text: 그러던 어느 날, 밖에서 놀고 있었어요.
lines.en: Then one day, Ihyun was playing outside.
segs: Then one day, Ee-hyun was playing outside.

lines.text: 이현이는 빨간 자동차를 손에 들고 나비를 보았어요.
lines.en: Ihyun held the red car in his hand and saw a butterfly. Look!
segs: Ihyun held the red car in his hand and saw a butterfly. Look!

lines.text: 어! 나비다!
lines.en: Oh! A butterfly!

lines.text: 나비가 팔랑팔랑 날아가자, 이현이는 폴짝폴짝 따라갔어요.
lines.en: The butterfly fluttered away, flutter, flutter, and Ihyun went hopping after it, hop, hop.
segs: The butterfly fluttered away, flutter, flutter, and Ihyun went hopping after it, hop, hop.

lines.text: 노느라 그만 빨간 자동차를 톡, 놓고 말았어요.
lines.en: Ihyun was so busy playing that the red car slipped out, plop, onto the grass.
segs: Ee-hyun was so busy playing that the red car slipped out, plop, onto the grass.

lines.text: 나비는 훨훨, 저 멀리 꽃밭 너머로 날아가 버렸어요.
lines.en: The butterfly flapped and fluttered far, far away, over the flower field and out of sight.
segs: The butterfly flapped and fluttered far, far away, over the flower field and out of sight.

lines.text: 정신을 차려 보니… 어라? 빨간 자동차가 보이지 않아요!
lines.en: And then... huh? The red car was nowhere to be seen!
segs: And then... huh? The red car was nowhere to be seen!

lines.text: 이현이는 자동차를 찾으며 눈물을 뚝뚝 흘렸어요.
lines.en: Ihyun looked and looked for his car, and his tears fell, drip, drop.
segs: Ihyun looked and looked for his car, and his tears fell, drip, drop.

lines.text: 잉잉, 내 빨간 자동차 어디 갔지?
lines.en: Boo-hoo, where did my red car go?
segs: Boo-hoo, where did my red car go?

lines.text: 이현이가 떠난 자리에 빨간 자동차만 혼자 남았어요.
lines.en: Ihyun went away, and the red car was left all alone on the grass.
segs: Ihyun went away, and the red car was left all alone on the grass.

lines.text: 홀로 남은 빨간 자동차는 이현이를 찾기로 했어요. 용기 있게 출발!
lines.en: The little red car, all alone, decided to go and find Ihyun. Off it went, brave and bold!
segs: The little red car, all alone, decided to go and find Ee-hyun. Off it went, brave and bold!

lines.text: 작은 바퀴가 덜덜 떨렸지만, 씩씩하게 데굴데굴 굴러갔어요.
lines.en: Its little wheels wobbled and shook, but bravely it rolled on, round and round.
segs: Its little wheels wobbled and shook, but bravely it rolled on, round and round.

lines.text: 부릉부릉! 이현이를 찾아 장난감 세상으로 가자!
lines.en: Vroom vroom! Let's go to Toy Land and find Ihyun!
segs: Vroom vroom! Let's go to Toy Land and find Ee-hyun!

lines.text: 끼이익, 장난감 세상의 커다란 문이 열렸어요.
lines.en: Creeeak! The great big gate of Toy Land swung open.
segs: Creeeak! The great big gate of Toy Land swung open.

lines.text: 열린 문을 지나자 장난감 친구들이 사는 세상이 나왔어요.
lines.en: Through the open gate, there it was: the world where toy friends live! Wow!
segs: Through the open gate, there it was: the world where toy friends live! Wow!

lines.text: 장난감 세상 길 위에서 빨간 자동차는 경찰차를 만났어요.
lines.en: On a road in Toy Land, the red car met a police car.
segs: On a road in Toy Land, the red car met a police car.

lines.text: 조금 가다 보니, 삐뽀삐뽀 우렁찬 소리가 들렸어요.
lines.en: A little way down the road, there came a loud wee-woo, wee-woo!
segs: A little way down the road, there came a loud wee-woo, wee-woo!

lines.text: 경찰차 형아가 도둑 장난감들에게 외쳤어요.
lines.en: Big brother police car shouted at the toy robbers,
segs: Big brother police car shouted at the toy robbers,

lines.text: 게 멈춰라!
lines.en: Stop right there!

lines.text: 경찰차 장난감이 도둑 장난감들을 쫓아 씽씽 달리고 있었어요.
lines.en: A toy police car was zooming after some toy robbers.
segs: A toy police car was zooming after some toy robbers.

lines.text: 도둑 장난감들이 깜짝 놀라 두 손을 번쩍 들었어요.
lines.en: The toy robbers jumped in surprise and threw their hands straight up in the air.
segs: The toy robbers jumped in surprise and threw their hands straight up in the air.

lines.text: 어? 너는 이현이가 잃어버렸던 경찰차 형아?!
lines.en: Huh? You're the police car Ihyun lost! Big brother police car!
segs: Huh? You're the police car Ee-hyun lost! Big brother police car!

lines.text: 우리 같이 이현이한테 가자!
lines.en: Let's go find Ihyun together!

lines.text: 좋아! 도둑을 다 잡았으니 같이 가자!
lines.en: Sure! I've caught all the robbers, so let's go together!
segs: Sure! I've caught all the robbers, so let's go together!

lines.text: 경찰차 형아가 앞장섰어요.
lines.en: Big brother police car led the way.
segs: Big brother police car led the way.

lines.text: 빨간 자동차와 경찰차는 장난감 집들이 있는 길에 도착했어요.
lines.en: The red car and the police car came to a street full of toy houses.
segs: The red car and the police car came to a street full of toy houses.

lines.text: 가다 보니 이번엔 위이잉, 소리가 났어요.
lines.en: A little farther on, there came a wee-ooo sound.
segs: A little farther on, there came a wee-ooo sound.

lines.text: 소방차 이모가 불이 난 집 앞에서 외쳤어요.
lines.en: In front of the burning house, auntie fire truck called out,
segs: In front of the burning house, auntie fire truck called out,

lines.text: 조심하세요! 불을 끕니다!
lines.en: Stand back! I'm putting out the fire!
segs: Stand back! I'm putting out the fire!

lines.text: 소방차가 블록으로 만든 장난감 집에 난 불을 쉭쉭 끄고 있었어요.
lines.en: A fire truck was spraying water, whoosh whoosh, on a fire at a little block house.
segs: A fire truck was spraying water, whoosh whoosh, on a fire at a little block house.

lines.text: 쉭쉭, 치익! 불꽃이 하나, 둘, 셋, 모두 꺼졌어요.
lines.en: Whoosh, whoosh, hiss! The flames went out, one, two, three, all gone.
segs: Whoosh, whoosh, hiss! The flames went out, one, two, three, all gone.

lines.text: 어? 소방차 이모! 우리 같이 이현이 만나러 가요!
lines.en: Oh? Auntie fire truck! Come with us to find Ihyun!
segs: Oh? Auntie fire truck! Come with us to find Ee-hyun!

lines.text: 그래그래! 불을 다 껐으니 같이 가자!
lines.en: Of course! The fire is out, so let's go together!
segs: Of course! The fire is out, so let's go together!

lines.text: 소방차 이모도 신나게 함께했어요.
lines.en: Auntie fire truck happily joined the group.
segs: Auntie fire truck happily joined the group.

lines.text: 세 친구는 장난감 병원 앞길로 달려갔어요.
lines.en: The three friends zoomed off to the road by the toy hospital. Vroom!
segs: The three friends zoomed off to the road by the toy hospital. Vroom!

lines.text: 셋이서 길을 가다 보니 삐용삐용, 바쁜 소리가 들렸어요.
lines.en: As the three drove on, there came a busy nee-naw, nee-naw!
segs: As the three drove on, there came a busy nee-naw, nee-naw!

lines.text: 구급차 삼촌이 아픈 인형들을 태우고 병원으로 가고 있었지요.
lines.en: Uncle ambulance was taking some sick dolls to the hospital.
segs: Uncle ambulance was taking some sick dolls to the hospital.

lines.text: 철컥! 문이 열리고, 인형들이 살금살금 병원으로 들어갔어요.
lines.en: Click! The door opened, and the dolls tiptoed quietly into the hospital.
segs: Click! The door opened, and the dolls tiptoed quietly into the hospital.

lines.text: 구급차 삼촌! 우리랑 같이 이현이한테 가요!
lines.en: Uncle ambulance! Come with us to find Ihyun!
segs: Uncle ambulance! Come with us to find Ee-hyun!

lines.text: 오냐오냐, 아픈 친구들을 다 데려다주었으니 이제 이현이에게 가자!
lines.en: All right, all right! I've brought the sick friends to the hospital, so now let's go to Ihyun!
segs: All right, all right! I've brought the sick friends to the hospital, so now let's go to Ee-hyun!

lines.text: 구급차 삼촌도 든든하게 따라나섰어요.
lines.en: Uncle ambulance came along too, strong and steady.
segs: Uncle ambulance came along too, strong and steady.

lines.text: 병원을 떠난 친구 넷은 긴 길로 나왔어요.
lines.en: The four friends left the hospital and came out onto a long, long road.
segs: The four friends left the hospital and came out onto a long, long road.

lines.text: 넷이서 나란히 달려요. 친구들이 소리로 인사했어요.
lines.en: The four friends drove side by side. They said hello with their sounds.
segs: The four friends drove side by side. They said hello with their sounds.

lines.text: 경찰차는 삐뽀삐뽀, 소방차는 위이잉, 구급차는 삐용삐용!
lines.en: The police car went wee-woo, the fire truck went wee-ooo, and the ambulance went nee-naw!
segs: The police car went wee-woo, the fire truck went wee-ooo, and the ambulance went nee-naw!

lines.text: 자, 다 같이 이현이한테 가자!
lines.en: Come on, everyone, let's go to Ihyun!
segs: Come on, everyone, let's go to Ee-hyun!

lines.text: 친구 넷은 씽씽, 바람을 가르며 신나게 달렸어요.
lines.en: The four friends zoomed along, zip, zip, slicing through the wind, happy as could be.
segs: The four friends zoomed along, zip, zip, slicing through the wind, happy as could be.

lines.text: 친구 넷이 언덕길에 다다랐어요.
lines.en: The four friends reached a hilly road. Up, up, up!
segs: The four friends reached a hilly road. Up, up, up!

lines.text: 하지만 너무 오래 달린 빨간 자동차는 그만 툭, 멈춰 서고 말았어요.
lines.en: But the little red car had driven for so long that it stopped with a clunk.
segs: But the little red car had driven for so long that it stopped with a clunk.

lines.text: 아이고, 힘들어. 더는 못 가겠어…
lines.en: Oh dear, I'm so tired. I can't go any farther...
segs: Oh dear, I'm so tired. I can't go any farther...

lines.text: 바퀴가 무거워 꼼짝할 수가 없었지요.
lines.en: Its wheels felt so heavy it couldn't move at all.
segs: Its wheels felt so heavy it couldn't move at all.

lines.text: 빨간 자동차는 헉헉, 엔진이 식어 축 늘어졌어요.
lines.en: Huff, puff. The little red car's engine went cold, and it slumped right down.
segs: Huff, puff. The little red car's engine went cold, and it slumped right down.

lines.text: 그때, 저 멀리서 덜컹덜컹 든든한 소리가 들렸어요.
lines.en: Just then, from far away, came a sturdy clatter, clatter sound.
segs: Just then, from far away, came a sturdy clatter, clatter sound.

lines.text: 걱정 마! 내가 도와줄게!
lines.en: Don't worry! I'll help you!

lines.text: 바로 이현이가 전에 잃어버렸던 주황색 견인차였어요!
lines.en: It was the orange tow truck Ihyun had lost long ago!
segs: It was the orange tow truck Ee-hyun had lost long ago!

lines.text: 견인차가 튼튼한 고리로 빨간 자동차를 찰칵! 걸어 주었어요.
lines.en: The tow truck hooked its strong hook onto the red car. Click!
segs: The tow truck hooked its strong hook onto the red car. Click!

lines.text: 영차, 영차!
lines.en: Heave-ho, heave-ho!

lines.text: "고마워, 견인차야! 이제 다시 갈 수 있어!"
lines.en: Thank you, tow truck! Now I can go again!
segs: Thank you, tow truck! Now I can go again!

scenes.card: All in a Row Like a Train

lines.text: 다섯 자동차 친구는 언덕을 지나 긴 길로 나왔어요.
lines.en: The five car friends went over the hill and out onto a long road.
segs: The five car friends went over the hill and out onto a long road.

lines.text: 견인차가 빨간 자동차를 앞에서 끌고, 그 뒤로 다른 차들이 든든하게 따랐어요.
lines.en: The tow truck pulled the red car from the front, and the other cars followed close behind.
segs: The tow truck pulled the red car from the front, and the other cars followed close behind.

lines.text: 맨 앞에서 견인차가 영차영차, 그 뒤로 친구들이 줄줄이 따라가요.
lines.en: At the very front, the tow truck pulled, heave-ho, heave-ho, and the friends followed along in a long, long line.
segs: At the very front, the tow truck pulled, heave-ho, heave-ho, and the friends followed along in a long, long line.

lines.text: 긴 기차처럼 한 줄로 칙칙폭폭, 붕붕붕!
lines.en: Like a long train, all in a row: chugga-chugga, vroom vroom vroom!
segs: Like a long train, all in a row: chugga-chugga, vroom vroom vroom!

lines.text: 덜컹덜컹, 부릉부릉, 삐뽀삐뽀! 신나는 소리가 길에 가득했어요.
lines.en: Clatter, clatter, vroom, vroom, wee-woo, wee-woo! The road was filled with happy sounds.
segs: Clatter, clatter, vroom, vroom, wee-woo, wee-woo! The road was filled with happy sounds.

lines.text: 마침내 놀이터에 있는 이현이를 만났어요!
lines.en: At last, they found Ihyun at the playground!
segs: At last, they found Ee-hyun at the playground!

lines.text: 와아! 내 빨간 자동차다!
lines.en: Wow! My red car!

lines.text: 경찰차랑 소방차, 구급차랑 견인차도 다 여기 있네!
lines.en: And the police car, the fire truck, the ambulance and the tow truck are all here too!
segs: And the police car, the fire truck, the ambulance and the tow truck are all here too!

lines.text: 이현이는 소중한 보물 자동차들을 모두 품에 안고 펄쩍펄쩍 기뻐했답니다.
lines.en: Ihyun hugged all the precious toy cars and jumped for joy.
segs: Ee-hyun hugged all the precious toy cars and jumped for joy.

lines.text: 자동차 친구들도 빵빵! 부릉부릉! 신이 나서 소리쳤어요.
lines.en: The car friends honked and roared with joy. Beep, beep! Vroom, vroom!
segs: The car friends honked and roared with joy. Beep, beep! Vroom, vroom!

lines.text: 이제 모두 함께 집으로 출발!
lines.en: Now let's all go home together!
segs: Now let's all go home together!

lines.text: 서로 도우면 혼자서는 못 가는 길도 함께 갈 수 있답니다.
lines.en: When we help each other, we can travel together down roads we could never travel alone.
segs: When we help each other, we can travel together down roads we could never travel alone.
